components.name: Icon
inherits: React HTML attributes for the underlying element

props.name: showAccentLine
props.description: Minimal variant: set false to drop the short rule above the title.

props.name: items
props.description: For variants with multiple items (three-flow, three-caption, stacked, column-image-text)

props.name: style
props.description: CSS variable overrides for layout customization per instance

props.name: image
props.description: Image path rendered at the top of the card instead of the icon (e.g. a transparent-background illustration).

props.name: highlight
props.description: Highlight this card with an accent border + subtle accent background.

props.name: color
props.description: Override this card's background color (icon/title/description switch to white text automatically).

props.name: badge
props.description: Badge label shown at the top-right corner (e.g. "重要").

props.name: badgeIcon
props.description: Optional icon name rendered before the badge label (e.g. "crown").
